paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: According to mythology who was the last of the Satavahana kings?
x: According to the Matsya Purana, Chanda Sri Satakarni was the last of the Satavahana kings. But the last Satavahana king recorded in history was Pulomavi III.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: Which inscription mentions Nigam Sabha of Satavahanas?
x: Nigamas were towns whose affairs were looked after by civic assemblies called Nigama sabhas. The Bhattiprolu inscription refers to Nigama sabhas.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: Who has the title "Shyadwadachala Simha"?
x: Titles of Somadeva Suri were Shyadvadachala Simha, Tarkika Chakravarthi and Kaviraja.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: Which was the capital of Ikshvakas?
x: Vasishtiputra Shantamula, founder of the Ikshvaku kingdom, ruled with Vijayapuri as capital. Vijayashri Satakarni built the town of Vijayapuri in his name.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: Which was the capital of Salankayanas?
x: According to the Eluru Prakrit copper plate, Vijayadeva Varma, founder of the Salankayana kingdom, established the kingdom with Vengipuram as its capital.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: What is the Royal language of Satavahanas?
x: Both the official language of the Satavahanas and the language of their inscriptions was Prakrit. Hala wrote the Gathasaptasati in Prakrit.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: Which religion did the Salankayanas follow?
x: The Salankayanas' royal emblem was Nandi, indicating they were originally devotees of Shiva. Their founder Vijayadevavarma called himself 'Parama Mahesvara'.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: Who was the greatest king of Eastern Chalukyas?
x: Vijayaditya-III, known as Gunaga Vijayaditya, was the greatest of all the Eastern Chalukyas.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: Who patronized Nannaya Bhattu?
x: Nannaya, the court poet of Rajaraja Narendra, translated 2 1/2 parvas of the Mahabharata into Telugu.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: Chalukya-Cholas First king?
x: Rajaraja Narendra's son Rajendra ascended the Chola throne at Thanjavur with the title 'Kulothunga'. His descendants are known as Chalukya Cholas.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: Which was an important port town in Kakatiya kingdom?
x: Motupalli was the important Kakatiya port, where Ganapatideva issued an Abhaya Shasanam in 1244 to protect foreign traders. Marco Polo visited it in 1292.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: What was the religion practiced by the early Kakatiya rulers?
x: The early Kakatiyas were originally Jains, as Jainism was popular under the patronage of the Western Chalukyas. Later Jainism declined with the rise of Shaivism.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: Under whose patronage was the thousand pillared temple of Hanmakonda built?
x: Prataparudra I (Rudradeva) built the Thousand Pillared Temple (Rudresvaralayam) at Anumakonda in 1163 AD. It is a Trikoota temple dedicated to the Sun God, Vasudeva and Rudreshwara.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: A foreign traveler who visited Andhra during the reign of Rudramadevi?
x: Marco Polo travelled in Andhra during the last period of Rudrama Devi's reign. In his book 'Travels' he praised the textiles exported from Motupalli.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: "Prataparudrayasobhushan" is written by?
x: Vidyanatha (original name Agastya), court poet of Prataparudra-II, glorified him in Prataparudra Yasobhushanam.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: Which is the Popular religion during the time of Reddy Rajas?
x: Veerashaivam was the main religion during the time of the Reddy Rajas, who were devotees of Shaivism.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: Who among the following is considered as author of Sangeeta Chintamani?
x: Pedda Komati Vemareddy wrote Sangeetha Chintamani, Sahitya Chintamani and Srungara Deepika. His titles were Sarvajna Chakravarthy and Kaviraja.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: Erra Pragada was an educationist in whose court?
x: Errapragada was the court poet of Prolaya Vemareddy and dedicated his 'Hari Vamsamu' to him.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p65
s: What is "meruka" a tax on?
x: The tax levied on Magani lands was called Meruka.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: During the Reddy Rajas time which text gives extensive information about sea trade?
x: Haravilasam, written by Srinatha and dedicated to Avachi Tippayashetti, gives extensive information about sea trade during the time of the Reddy Rajas.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: Who argued that the Ikshvakus were Telugu peoples?
x: Caldwell held that the Ikshvakus were natives (Andhras). Gopalachari held that they came from the Tamil country, and Vogel from Kannada desha.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: The Nasik Inscription of Gautami Balashri was engraved during whose reign?
x: The Nasik Prasasti of Gautami Balasri, mother of Gautamiputra Satakarni, is dated in the 19th regnal year of Vasishtiputra Pulomavi. It describes the victories of Gautamiputra Satakarni.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: Which ruler of Vijayanagara tried to increase his military wealth by enlisting ten thousand Muslim nobles in his army?
x: According to Ferishta, Devaraya-II enlisted Muslims in his army along with large numbers of infantry, archers and horsemen.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: Persian ambassador who visited the court of the Devaraya-II?
x: Abdur Razak visited the Vijayanagara court in 1443, during the reign of Devaraya-II, as ambassador of the Persian king.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: What is the meaning of the word 'Shalankayana'?
x: Shalankayana is a gotra name; the Sanskrit Medinikosham says Shalankayana means Nandi. Their royal symbol was Nandi.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: Who wrote the book "Forgotten Empire"?
x: Robert Sewell, an official of the Madras Presidency, wrote 'A Forgotten Empire: Vijayanagar', which also describes the Rakshasi-Tangadi battle.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: Who wrote the commentary titled "Sangita Sudhakaram" on Sharngadhara's Sangeeta Ratnakaramu?
x: Sangita Sudhakaram, a commentary on Sangeeta Ratnakaram, was authored by Singabhupala-II.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: Who was the contemporary of Vaggeyakara Annamayya?
x: Tallapaka Annamacharya, titled 'Pada Sankirtana Pithamaha', lived during the reign of Saluva Narasimharaya.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: Who wrote Veerabhadra Vijaya?
x: Potana's works include Virabhadra Vijayam, Bhogini Dandakam, Narayana Shatakam and Andhra Mahabhagavatam.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: "Andhra Suratrana" is a popular title of whom?
x: 'Andhra Suratrana' is the title of Kapaya Nayaka.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: Who built Veerashiro Mantapa in Srisailam?
x: Anavema Reddy built the Veera Shiro Mandapam at Srisailam and the Anavemapuri Mandapam at Simhachalam.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: Kohinoor diamond was found in which mines?
x: The Kohinoor diamond was discovered at Kollur in Guntur district during the Qutb Shahi period.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: Who was the Italian traveler who visited South India during the reign of Deva Raya II?
x: Italian traveller Nicolo Conti visited Vijayanagara in 1442 AD (reign of Devaraya-II) and described its circumference as 60 miles.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: Which Inscription mentioned the musical instrument "Jalakaranda"?
x: The Dharmasagara inscription of the Kakatiya period mentions a musical instrument called 'Jalakaranda'.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p66
s: Which of the following cities is known to be home to actors based on Kreedabhiramam?
x: Vinukonda Vallabhamatya's Kridabhiramam describes the social life, sports and dramas of the time and shows that heroic stories were popular in Orugallu.
